mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_order(order_no, customer_id, product_id, quantity, amount_cents, status, created_at) VALUES (#{orderNo}, #{customerId}, #{productId}, #{quantity}, #{amountCents}, #{status}, NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT id, order_no, customer_id, product_id, quantity, amount_cents, status, created_at FROM t_order WHERE order_no = #{orderNo} LIMIT 1
